name: long-run-ping
description: Pings you when a long model turn or a long Bash command ends, so you can look away: /long-run-ping [on|off|status|test].

enabled.title: Enable long-run-ping
enabled.description: Turn off to make the mod do nothing.

afterSec.title: Turn length that earns a ping (seconds)
afterSec.description: A model turn that takes longer than this gets a ping when it ends.

commandSec.title: Bash command length that earns a ping (seconds)
commandSec.description: A single Bash command that takes longer than this gets a ping when it ends.

minGapSec.title: Least time between pings (seconds)
minGapSec.description: No second ping inside this time.

sound.title: Play a sound and send a notification
sound.description: On: a short sound and a terminal notification come with the toast. Off: the toast only.
